card.lecture_title: Environmental Causes of Cancer and Genetic Basis of Tumorigenesis
topics: Environmental mutagens and their role in cancer (e.g., mutagenic compounds, X-rays, UV)
Enzymatic conversion and spontaneous reactions with DNA (e.g., N7 of guanosine)
Cancer arises in actively dividing cells (carcinoma, leukemia, lymphoma, sarcoma)
Cancer as a genetic disease of somatic cells due to mutations releasing growth constraints
Incidence of stomach cancer by age and gender (data from 1975 and 1992)
Multiple mutations required for tumor formation; different tumors have different mutated genes
Early initiating events are rare and hard to detect; often lead to increased mutation rates
Synergistic effect of oncogenic myc and ras in tumor formation (shown in graph)
Isolation of the Ras oncogene from human tumor cells
